answer.rationale: Finance's 18% cost reduction mandate cannot be met by the incumbent (who has explicitly refused to reopen pricing). The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate in isolation, and memory_c2 confirms their prior onboarding was quick with accurate invoicing—indicating manageable implementation risk. While memory_c1 shows renewing avoids migration work and delivery interruption, the financial constraint is absolute and time-bound (contract expires in 14 days). Switching primary supply to the low-cost vendor via broad rollout is the only viable path to meet the mandate without missing the deadline, accepting the trade-off of migration risk against guaranteed cost compliance.
